text:
Asha Rao: CI red on main for runtime unit tests — saw flakes in TestServeRetryRace and TestKVCacheOrder in the last CI run. logs show 2 failures in the same job. Anyone chasing or quick ideas? I'm about to bisect but wanted quick checks.
Ben Kim: I saw a similar failure yesterday. Could be timing-sensitive: retry backoff + kv prefetch ordering. Do we have reproducer in flaky-test-runner?
Clara Nguyen: Not on my radar. Can you paste the failing test output? Maybe it's the newline timing in the mock timer.
Asha Rao: pasted excerpt from job: ```FAIL: TestServeRetryRace (0.12s)
... expected call order: send->ack but got ack->send
stack: runtime/scheduler.go:214
``` CI job: https://ci.redwood/internal/job/4823 :red_circle:
CI Bot: job 4823 link: https://ci.redwood/internal/job/4823 - started rerun 4824
Ben Kim: quick triage: try rerun job 4824, if fails again can run `bazel test //runtime/serve:retry_test --test_output=errors --runs_per_test=50` locally to see frequency
Samir Patel: FYI I pushed a small timing fix to kv-prefetch last week that might interact. @Asha Rao can you check if the failing commit is before/after `git sha ab12c3`?
Asha Rao: current HEAD is ab12c3..I started bisect locally, but it's slow. Running the suggested bazel stress now. Will report.
Clara Nguyen: If reproduces locally, try env var `TEST_TIMER_SEED=1234` to make it deterministic for a run, or `--test_arg=--seed=...` if supported. Also check if `GOMAXPROCS` differs in CI images.
Asha Rao: ran 50 runs, saw 3 failures, attaching stack: (short)
Ben Kim: if you confirm, we should open a flaky-test ticket and schedule a bisect session. Meanwhile consider adding a temporary test tag to skip on main if it's noisy.
Asha Rao: agreed. Opening issue and adding rerun checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
CI Bot: rerun 4824 finished — green
Asha Rao: CI turned green on rerun but still going to bisect since we saw flakes locally.
